curlshot.description: CurlShot hosted MCP — screenshot API for agents. take_screenshot renders any URL in a real browser and returns the image so the model can see it, or a PDF or scrolling video; supports full page, device presets, dark mode and single-element capture. list_devices returns the available device presets. Streamable HTTP, nothing to install. Get an API key at https://curlshot.com (free plan: 100 screenshots/month, no credit card; paid plans from $19/month). Docs: https://curlshot.com/docs.
